    string line;
    getline(cin, line);
    stringstream ss(line);
    long long n, m;
    ss >> n >> m;
    
    if (n > m) {
        long long tmp = n;
        n = m;
        m = tmp;
    }
    
    long long sol = 0;
    
    if (m < 3) {

        sol = m % 6;
        if (sol > 3) sol = 6 - sol;
        cout << m - sol << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    
    if (n == 2) {
        sol = m * n;
        if (m == 3) sol = 4;
        if (m == 7) sol = 12;
    } else if (n == 3) {
        sol = m * n;
        if (m % 2 == 1) sol -= 1;
    } else {
        if (m % 2 == 1 && n % 2 == 1) sol = m * n - 1;
        else sol = m * n;
    }
    
    cout << sol << endl;
    return 0;
}
